title: Geothermal Electricity Ordinance Extraction Schema
description: Extract regulatory requirements from county/municipal ordinances governing geothermal electricity generation facilities. Extract ONLY requirements for geothermal ELECTRICITY generation: geothermal power plants (flash steam, binary cycle, dry steam), geothermal production/injection wells for electricity, commercial geothermal energy facilities, and geothermal exploration for power generation. EXCLUDE: geothermal heat pumps (GHP), residential geothermal HVAC systems, direct-use geothermal heating/cooling, general zoning unrelated to geothermal power, solar power facilities, wind power facilities, and all other non-geothermal renewable energy.

applies_to_geothermal_electricity.description: True if ordinance regulates geothermal ELECTRICITY generation (geothermal power plants, geothermal wells for electricity production). False if only GHP, residential heating, solar, wind, or other non-geothermal energy.

extraction_approach.description: Explicitly state what was EXTRACTED and what was EXCLUDED. Required format: 'Extracted [specific geothermal sections/provisions]; Excluded [non-geothermal sections like solar, wind, GHP, etc.]' This forces careful filtering.
examples: Extracted geothermal power plant provisions from Section 6-3A-3; Excluded solar power requirements from Section 6-4-12G and residential GHP from Section 6-3C-2
Extracted commercial geothermal energy regulations from Division 17; Excluded general zoning and non-geothermal renewables
Document only addresses solar and wind energy - no geothermal electricity provisions found; Excluded all content

state.description: State name exactly as written in document (e.g., 'California', 'Nevada', 'Colorado').

county.description: County name exactly as written (e.g., 'Imperial County', 'Chaffee County'). Do not remove 'County' suffix.

ordinance_code.description: Ordinance number/code exactly as written (e.g., 'Chapter 26.138', 'Resolution 2013-33', 'Division 17'). Leave null if not stated.

requirements.description: Array of distinct GEOTHERMAL ELECTRICITY requirements. DO NOT include requirements from solar, wind, biomass, or other non-geothermal sections. Each unique geothermal requirement = one entry. FOR SETBACKS: Create separate entries for each target (e.g., if '40 feet from street, 15 feet from property line', make TWO entries). CRITICAL: Verify each requirement applies to GEOTHERMAL, not solar/wind/other.

type.description: High-level requirement category for GEOTHERMAL facilities only.

subtype.description: Specific subcategory for GEOTHERMAL operations. Examples: 'Drilling operations', 'Power plant operations', 'Production well', 'Injection well'. NEVER use 'Solar power' or 'Wind power' subtypes - those should be excluded entirely. Leave null if not applicable.

target.description: CRITICAL FOR SETBACKS: Specify what the distance is measured FROM (the reference point). Examples: setback FROM 'Residence', FROM 'Property line', FROM 'Rivers/streams'. For NON-SETBACK requirements: what the requirement applies TO (e.g., 'All facilities', 'Production wells'). NEVER use 'Power plant' as setback target - identify the actual feature being set back FROM.

value.description: Numeric requirement exactly as stated (e.g., 300, 1320, 65, 7.5) or time range (e.g., '7 a.m. to 7 p.m.'). Extract numbers without units. For yes/no requirements, use null and describe in details field. Examples: '1,320 feet' → 1320; '65 dBA' → 65.

unit.description: Unit of measurement exactly as written in ordinance (e.g., 'feet', 'dBA', 'acres', 'days'). Leave null if no unit.

details.description: Complete requirement text extracted verbatim from ordinance. Include all conditions, exceptions, qualifications exactly as written. This is the authoritative source - preserve exact legal language. CRITICAL: Only extract text that applies to GEOTHERMAL electricity, not solar/wind/other energy. Do NOT paraphrase.

section.description: Ordinance section reference exactly as cited (e.g., '§ 91703.01 G', 'Section 10-404(2)(c)', 'Chapter 26.138.050'). If same requirement appears in multiple sections, list all separated by commas. Leave null only if ordinance has no section numbering.
